items.title: Josiah Gluck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 13, 2022
items.q: I didn’t work on Joe with his track.

ctx.x: I love those kind of stories. You did — actually there’s a name on your list of a fellow who is very important to our project here, Joe Williams. And he was on that “Happy Anniversary Charlie Brown” record.
Yes. That was recorded in many different places and I didn’t work on Joe with his track.
